crossRefs.note: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:
For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,
Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. Nabal’s heart was merry…
The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king…
Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until…
The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh…
In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a…
Those who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
“Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
Then Joab came to the king, and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him…
You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all…
I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May Yahweh reward the…
There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.
The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly…

translations.web: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
translations.bsb: Luxury is unseemly for a fool— how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!
translations.kjv: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
translations.asv: Delicate living is not seemly for a fool; Much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
